results.title: NSITF seeks stronger enforcement of Employees’ Compensation Act to protect workers’ rights
results.description: By Johnbosco AgbakwuruABUJA — MANAGING Director and Chief Executive of the Nigeria Social Insurance Trust Fund (NSITF), Mr. Oluwaseun Faleye, has urged the judiciary to strengthen the interpretation, adjudication, and enforcement of the Employees’ Compensation Act (ECA) 2010, so that Nigerian workers can fully enjoy the justice and protection the law guarantees. The Act provides compensation […] The post NSITF seeks stronger enforcement of Employees’ Compensation Act to protect workers’ rights appeared first on Vanguard News.
